objectives.text: ZX***学院 provides educational operation services and related educational equipment products for applied undergraduate and higher vocational colleges.
The core of the educational operation service is the construction of 'industry colleges' in collaboration with domestic universities.
The company is responsible for providing a comprehensive package of educational operation services for the 'industry colleges', including teaching management and curriculum development.
The sales of educational equipment products are based on the practical teaching needs of the colleges.
ZX***学院 has achieved a 100% employment rate for its students.
The organization reports a 97% employment satisfaction rate among its graduates.
ZX***学院 aims to create a light-asset industry college model that is co-built and co-managed.
ZX***学院 supports the development of strategic emerging industries such as semiconductors and integrated circuits.
The organization aims to build a 100% dual-qualified teaching staff.
In 2020, the enrollment in higher education institutions reached 9.67 million students.
The total number of students in higher education institutions reached 32.85 million in 2020.
In 2020, the number of college enrollments reached 9.67 million.
In 2020, the number of students attending regular higher education institutions reached 32.85 million.
The enrollment numbers of regular higher education institutions showed a general upward trend from 2010 to 2020.
The number of students attending regular higher education institutions increased from 2.23 million in 2010 to 3.28 million in 2020.
The talent demand in the integrated circuit industry is predicted to reach 744,500 by 2022, with a talent gap of over 340,000.
China's integrated circuit industry market size has been rapidly growing, with a compound annual growth rate of 19.62% from 2015 to 2019.
China's analog integrated circuit products account for approximately 45% of the world's output, while its analog chip production only accounts for about 10% of the global share.
The domestic production rate of analog chips in China is less than 1%.
The integrated circuit industry in China faces a shortage of leading and high-end talent, which limits its attractiveness for talent.
The quality of professional construction in higher education institutions urgently needs improvement.
The structure of professional programs is single and does not connect with the industrial chain for multi-professional integration.
The talent training model requires innovation.
The construction of internship and training bases is weak.
The level of the teaching staff is not high.
There is insufficient deep involvement of industry enterprises in curriculum development and course construction.
There is a lack of high-quality collaborative courses, teaching materials, and engineering case collections between schools and enterprises.
The integration of education and research is insufficient, with inadequate interaction between research and talent training.
